Summarize a panfmm fit

Source: R/fmm.R
summary.panfmm.Rd

Summarize a panfmm fit

Usage

# S3 method for class 'panfmm'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

a "panfmm" fit

...

unused

Value

an object of class "summary.panfmm": a list with one coefficient table per class (classes: estimate, standard error, z value and p-value, ancillary parameter on the log scale), the table of the class-probability (multinomial logit) parameters (prior), the mean class probabilities, the class sizes by modal posterior class, and the fit information (call, loglik, AIC, BIC, nobs, n_groups, vcov_type).

See also

Other panfmm methods: predict.panfmm(), vcov.panfmm()

Examples

set.seed(3)
d <- data.frame(id = rep(1:150, each = 3), t = rep(1:3, 150), x = rnorm(450))
d$y <- rpois(450, exp(ifelse(rep(rbinom(150, 1, 0.4), each = 3) == 1, 1.5, 0) + 0.3 * d$x))
summary(panfmm(y ~ x, data = d, index = c("id", "t"), nstart = 2, seed = 1))
#> 
#> Call:
#> panfmm(formula = y ~ x, data = d, index = c("id", "t"), nstart = 2, 
#>     seed = 1)
#> 
#> Model: 2-class latent class Poisson model 
#> N = 450  groups = 150  vcov: classical 
#>

#> x            0.24535    0.05846   4.197 2.71e-05 ***
#> ---

#>

#>             Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
#> (Intercept)  1.48145    0.04063  36.460   <2e-16 ***
#> x            0.32210    0.03908   8.241   <2e-16 ***
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
#>
